title: builder boundary matches module prefixes by string, not path segment
detail: consistency.builder_writes_within_plan tests rel_str.startswith(m.rstrip('/')). So a declared api/x also matches api/xyz.py, a bullet whose first word is prose such as 'A' yields prefix a (seen in 2 of 157 real scopes after v0.234.0), and a bullet head of / or . still matches every file or every dotfile. Fix: compare on path segments, and reject an empty or root module in validate_scope. Left out of one-modules-parser, which only stops backticked prose from declaring modules. Joined-span heuristic limits from the same sprint: a joined extensionless name (Makefile) declares nothing, and a joined dotted symbol (foo.bar) reads as a path.
